meta.what_this_is: A hand-off from Claude to Grok, for the Economic Report Influence Graph corpus. Two lists. `find_a_url` are report nodes that still have no usable URL after two full rounds of web research. `improve_a_url` are nodes where the best URL found is the right official series page but is not specific to that node — several of them share one link. Everything here has already been genuinely searched; `what_we_hit` records exactly what was tried and why it failed, so you can skip the dead ends rather than repeat them.
meta.the_one_rule: A URL goes in ONLY if you actually retrieved the page and saw that it is the right publication. A plausible-looking guessed URL is worse than no URL, because a wrong link stays invisible until somebody clicks it. Returning null with an honest reason is a correct and expected answer, not a failure.

what_counts_as_a_good_url: On the publisher's own official domain — a government, central bank, national statistics office, or multilateral body.
The specific product or series landing page for that publication. A series landing page is correct for a recurring publication.

NOT a publisher homepage. NOT Wikipedia. NOT a news article. NOT a data aggregator (CEIC, TradingEconomics, Statista, Macrotrends). NOT a search-results page. NOT a mirror, archive, or third-party republication.
Native-language pages are perfectly fine and are often the only ones that exist.

If the publication genuinely does not exist, or the publisher is not an eligible body (a SIPRI estimate rather than a government series, a corporate publisher, an industry association), say so plainly — that is the useful answer.
routes_that_worked_for_us: Alternate and successor hostnames — the highest-yield trick by far. Ministries get reorganised and domains move: fia.mpi.gov.vn became fia.mof.gov.vn; cucthongkehanoi.gso.gov.vn became thongkehanoi.nso.gov.vn; ipb.moea.gov.tw is alive as land.bip.gov.tw; eticaret.gov.tr content now sits under ticaret.gov.tr/data/; stat.gov.tw serves census PDFs that dgbas.gov.tw refuses.

Sitemaps — /sitemap.xml, /sitemap_index.xml, or whatever robots.txt names. This is how to recover real URLs from JavaScript-only sites that render nothing to a plain fetch. It cracked the UAE's FCSC and Guyana's CHPA.

Static asset paths behind a JavaScript front end. asean.org/wp-content/uploads/... served a full PDF even though every HTML page there is a JS shell; media.kemenkeu.go.id served Indonesia's budget PDF where the main site is a shell; www.tuik.gov.tr/indir/ hosts real PDFs while the TurkStat data portal is unusable.

Substituting the co-publisher. Where a ministry site is blocked, the national statistics office often publishes the same series — the Philippine PSA carried four items whose originating agencies were unreachable.
The publisher's own on-site search endpoint as a discovery tool, then fetching the real product page. Never return the search URL itself.

A warning, so you do not waste time: the IMF DSBB / NSDP route (dsbb.imf.org) looks perfect for this and is not. It is a JavaScript single-page app that renders only template placeholders like {{country.NSDPUrl}}. Three separate attempts got nothing from it. Vietnam's own NSDP mirror at nsdp.nso.gov.vn did work, so national NSDP mirrors are worth a look even though the IMF's aggregator is not.

how_to_reply.format: Return one JSON object and nothing else around it — no commentary before or after.

results.confirmed: <one or two sentences: what you actually saw on the page that proves it is this publication — a title, a figure, a coverage period. If null, why: domain dead, series discontinued, no such product, publisher not eligible.>
results.route: <how you found it: successor-domain / sitemap / static-asset / co-publisher / on-site-search / other>

how_to_reply.important: Return an entry for EVERY id in both lists, in the order given, including the ones you could not solve. Do not invent ids that were not asked for. Do not change any other field.

find_a_url.title: National Accounts of Afghanistan (GDP)
find_a_url.description: Official and compiled national accounts (GDP). The economy contracted sharply after 2021; recent fiscal years show modest real growth but per-capita outcomes remain under pressure from population growth and structural constraints.
find_a_url.what_we_hit: Still not found. NSIA is unreachable by any hostname or port: nsia.gov.af, www.nsia.gov.af and nsia.gov.af:8443 all fail at the robots.txt stage with 'certificate verify failed: unable to get local issuer certificate', so no fetch can proceed. Alternative official hosts were checked and ruled out: invest.gov.af (which had mirrored the Statistical Yearbook) no longer resolves; Da Afghanistan Bank's statistics index (https://www.dab.gov.af/statistics) lists only exchange rates, currency auctions, capital notes, external-sector, monetary/fiscal and real-sector pages, and its Real Sector page carries only CPI, while https://www.dab.gov.af/Financial-Statistics is banking-sector-only with no macro aggregates. old.dab.gov.af's Real Sector page describes GDP compilation but publishes no data or files.

find_a_url.title: Agriculture production statistics
find_a_url.publisher: Ministry of Agriculture, Irrigation and Livestock / NSIA related
find_a_url.description: Statistics on crop and livestock production. Agriculture is the backbone of rural livelihoods and food security; wheat is the dominant staple. Production is highly sensitive to drought, water availability and input constraints.
find_a_url.what_we_hit: Still not found. mail.gov.af is reachable this time (via www.mail.gov.af) and its sitemap index and reports page were both read, but https://www.mail.gov.af/en/reports lists only project safeguard documents (OMAID ESMF, Barikab ESIA), anti-corruption strategy reports and ministry achievement summaries, the newest from 2021 - no crop or livestock production statistics. The sitemap files contain only news nodes and exhibition announcements. NSIA, the other candidate publisher, is unreachable (TLS chain failure on robots.txt for every hostname).

find_a_url.title: Wheat production statistics
find_a_url.description: Focused statistics on wheat area, yield and production. Wheat is the central food-security crop; production levels interact with imports, subsidies and climate variability.
find_a_url.what_we_hit: Still not found. No standalone official wheat-statistics publication page could be retrieved. The SCI agricultural portal (confirmed above) covers crops in aggregate but no wheat-specific page was reachable; the Ministry of Agriculture Jihad statistics page (maj.ir Index.aspx?...tempname=amar...) was located via search but maj.ir never answered across repeated attempts (robots.txt connect timeouts).

find_a_url.title: Non-oil export statistics
find_a_url.description: Aggregate and commodity-structure statistics on non-oil exports. Petrochemicals, minerals, agricultural products and other manufactures form the main residual external-earnings base under oil sanctions.
find_a_url.what_we_hit: Still not found. irica.ir does not resolve at all (DNS 'Name or service not known'), and the legacy irica.gov.ir host also failed DNS. The Trade Promotion Organization pages located via search (tpo.ir Persian non-oil-export-by-sector page, and tpo.ir/uploads/amar_tejarat_khareji_12_mahe.pdf) were attempted repeatedly and tpo.ir never answered.

find_a_url.title: Education enrolment and literacy statistics
find_a_url.description: Enrolment rates by level and literacy rates (including youth and gender-disaggregated figures). Youth literacy is high; overall adult literacy and higher-education attainment form the main human-capital stock indicators.
find_a_url.our_verdict: searched properly; no such published series found
find_a_url.what_we_hit: Still not found. The SCI Persian general-education page (/دادهها-و-اطلاعات-آماری/آموزش-و-پژوهش/آموزش-عمومی) and the guessed short slug /education-statistics were both located/attempted but never returned content across ~12 tries. The English topic page that did load (amar.org.ir/english/Statistics-by-Topic/Education-and-Research) turned out to be a Frascati-Manual R&D glossary with no enrolment or literacy content, so it is not the right document.

find_a_url.title: Housing and construction permit statistics
find_a_url.description: Statistics on building permits, residential units and construction activity. Housing investment and construction are sensitive to high inflation, credit conditions and urban demand.
find_a_url.our_verdict: searched properly; no such published series found
find_a_url.what_we_hit: Still not found. The real SCI slug /building-permit-system and the Persian path /دادهها-و-اطلاعات-آماری/ساختمان-و-مسکن/ساخت-و-ساز were both identified from indexed results and attempted more than 25 times over roughly an hour; amar.org.ir never served either during an up-window. Two indexed building-permit PDFs (/Portals/0/News/1400/1_par-2-1400.pdf and /Portals/0/Files/fulltext/1390/n_parvane_90_2.pdf) also never returned.

find_a_url.title: Non-performing loans and banking asset-quality statistics
find_a_url.publisher: Central Bank of Iran / bank disclosures
find_a_url.description: System-wide and bank-level non-performing loan and asset-quality indicators. Asset quality is a recurring concern under high inflation, sanctions and directed-credit pressures.
find_a_url.our_verdict: searched properly; no such published series found
find_a_url.what_we_hit: Still not found, and probably no discrete official product exists. cbi.ir answered several times (its national-accounts section 2054.aspx loaded fully) but no CBI page on non-performing / overdue claims (مطالبات غیرجاری) could be located or retrieved. The World Bank indicator page for 'Bank nonperforming loans to total gross loans - Iran, Islamic Rep.' loaded but showed no data values for Iran, so it does not confirm as the right document.

find_a_url.title: Social protection reform / National Social Protection Strategy
find_a_url.description: Ongoing reform of the social-assistance system (digitalisation, targeting, registry accuracy, reduction of duplication) under the National Social Protection Strategy.
find_a_url.our_verdict: searched properly; no such published series found
find_a_url.what_we_hit: Still not found. The Ministry of Social Affairs and Housing pages on gov.sr were re-checked in full: /beleidsgebieden/ lists only two policy areas (people with disabilities; senior citizens) and links no strategy document, and /documenten/ holds just two files (the 2014 Wet Opvanginstellingen and a Koopkrachtversterking authorisation form). Suriname's National Social Protection Strategy exists as an ILO-supported process (ILO reports a validation workshop) but the Government of Suriname has not published the strategy text on any official site that could be retrieved; the only gov.sr material is news items about the reform, which are excluded.

find_a_url.title: Electricity generation and capacity statistics
find_a_url.publisher: Derived from Ministry of Electricity and monitoring sources
find_a_url.description: Statistics on electricity production and available capacity. Generation remains far below pre-war levels; chronic shortfalls, fuel constraints and damaged infrastructure are structural features. Limited renewable contribution is emerging.
find_a_url.what_we_hit: Still not found. A successor publisher was located and retrieved this time - tde.gov.sy, the Public Establishment for Transmission and Distribution of Electricity under the Ministry of Energy - but it publishes no statistics product: its full menu is About / News / Tenders / Conferences / SEEP / Laws and Regulations / Jobs / Industrial Cities / Sustainability / Media Office / Contact, with no statistics or reports section, and the homepage's 'peak generation yesterday' and 'total production yesterday' fields both render 0 MW / 0 MWh. tde.gov.sy/sitemap.xml returns 404. peegt.gov.sy no longer resolves, nerc.gov.sy fails TLS verification, and the Central Bureau of Statistics (cbssyr.sy) times out on connect, so its Statistical Abstract electricity chapter cannot be reached.

find_a_url.title: Syria–Turkey merchandise trade statistics
find_a_url.publisher: Derived from Turkish and Syrian trade monitoring sources
find_a_url.description: Bilateral trade with Turkey. Volumes have risen in the post-transition period; Turkey is a major source of imports and a key overland trade corridor. Multiple border crossings are active; trade growth is a leading indicator of external re-engagement.
find_a_url.what_we_hit: Still not found. On the Turkish side, the Ministry of Trade's foreign-trade statistics page (https://ticaret.gov.tr/istatistikler/dis-ticaret-istatistikleri) was retrieved but hosts no country-level files - it only redirects users to TurkStat's query system, whose landing pages sit on veriportali.tuik.gov.tr and serve a JavaScript-required stub; the Ministry's Syria country page (ticaret.gov.tr/yurtdisi-teskilati/orta-dogu/suriye) returns 404, and the circulating 'Suriye Ulke Profili' PDFs are hosted by chambers of commerce (aso.org.tr, deik.org.tr), not by the Ministry. On the Syrian side, cbssyr.sy is unreachable and Syria publishes no bilateral trade product. No single official document covers this relationship as a series.

find_a_url.title: Tourism arrivals and tourism revenue statistics
find_a_url.publisher: TurkStat / Ministry of Culture and Tourism related
find_a_url.description: Official statistics on international visitor arrivals and tourism receipts. Tourism is a major services credit in the balance of payments; recent years show arrivals in the 60+ million range and revenues above USD 60 billion.
find_a_url.what_we_hit: Still not found. TurkStat's Turizm Istatistikleri quarterly bulletins do exist (bulletin IDs such as /tr/press/54157 and /Bulten/Index?p=Turizm-Istatistikleri-... are indexed), but every path on veriportali.tuik.gov.tr - and data.tuik.gov.tr, which 302-redirects there - returns the same 'JavaScript Gerekli / JavaScript Required' stub, including /tr/press/<id>, /en/press/<id>, /Bulten/Index, /Bulten/DownloadIstatistikselTablo and even static-looking paths like /pdf/kilavuz.pdf. It is a catch-all SPA with no server-rendered fallback. The Ministry of Culture and Tourism is unreachable from here on every hostname tried (ktb.gov.tr, www.ktb.gov.tr, yigm.ktb.gov.tr, istatistik.ktb.gov.tr, kulturturizm.gov.tr all fail with connect timeout / DNS). tga.gov.tr (Tourism Promotion and Development Agency) renders but its Aylik Raporlar page exposes no report titles or download links without JavaScript. The only TurkStat document I could actually retrieve that contains tourism data is the compendium https://www.tuik.gov.tr/media/announcements/istatistiklerle_turkiye_2021.pdf, whose table of contents lists section 47 'Turizm / Tourism' - it is a genuine TurkStat publication but it is a general yearbook from 2021, not the Tourism Statistics product, so I am not recording it as the URL.

find_a_url.title: Taiwanese semiconductor investment and capacity expansion in the United States (official and reported figures)
find_a_url.publisher: MOEA / Investment Commission / US Commerce / industry reporting cited in official releases
find_a_url.description: Statistics and official commitments concerning Taiwanese semiconductor firms’ direct investment and capacity build-out in the United States (fabs, packaging, materials, equipment ecosystem). Figures in the hundreds of billions have been associated with the recent AIT–TECRO investment understandings.
find_a_url.our_verdict: searched properly; no such published series found
find_a_url.what_we_hit: Still not found, and on inspection this is not a single official publication. MOEA's Investment Review Section publishes approved outbound investment by destination country, and MOEA has given ad hoc briefings on semiconductor firms' US investment intentions, but there is no official statistical product that is 'Taiwanese semiconductor investment and capacity expansion in the United States'. The headline figures in the node (hundreds of billions, AIT-TECRO understandings) originate from company announcements, US Commerce statements and press reporting rather than a Taiwanese official series; everything I could reach on this was news coverage, which is excluded. Recording null rather than pointing at a generic outbound-investment statistics page, which would be the wrong document.

find_a_url.title: Bonos y transferencias monetarias del Estado
find_a_url.description: State cash bonuses and transfers that supplement household income alongside CLAP food boxes.
find_a_url.what_we_hit: Still not found. patria.org.ve (the Sistema Patria portal, the only official channel publishing the bonos/transfers) could not be retrieved on this attempt either - the robots.txt fetch times out on connect, so the host is effectively unreachable. No other Venezuelan government page for the transfer programme exists.

find_a_url.title: Faja Petrolífera del Orinoco — resource base
find_a_url.description: World’s largest known extra-heavy oil resource. Geographic and geological core of Venezuela’s long-run petroleum potential.
find_a_url.what_we_hit: Still not found. pdvsa.com has no DNS record (name resolution fails). The Ministry of Petroleum: www.minpet.gob.ve serves a certificate that is not valid for that hostname (TLS hostname mismatch) and minpet.gob.ve does not resolve at all. Both publisher domains are dead.

find_a_url.title: SENIAT — tax administration
find_a_url.description: National tax authority. Publishes residual tax-collection statistics that form the non-oil revenue side of the budget.
find_a_url.what_we_hit: Still not found. seniat.gob.ve and www.seniat.gob.ve both fail at the robots.txt stage with a connection timeout; the host resolves but never completes a request. No SENIAT statistics page could be retrieved.

find_a_url.title: Petróleos de Venezuela (PDVSA)
find_a_url.description: State oil company. Producer, exporter and fiscal contributor of the hydrocarbon sector.
find_a_url.what_we_hit: Still not found. pdvsa.com and www.pdvsa.com have no DNS A record; every fetch fails with 'Name or service not known'. The domain is permanently dead and no mirror is acceptable.

find_a_url.title: HumVenezuela — independent living-conditions diagnostics
find_a_url.description: Independent multi-source diagnostic platform that compiles and publishes state-level indicators of humanitarian and living-condition stress (services, health, food, etc.).
find_a_url.our_verdict: searched properly; no such published series found
find_a_url.what_we_hit: Still not found. humvenezuela.com is confirmed to still be serving a WordPress placeholder: both the homepage and /informes/ return only the site logo and Open Graph metadata ('Emergencia Humanitaria Compleja en Venezuela') with no report listing, and /sitemap.xml returns the same stub rather than a sitemap.

find_a_url.title: Ethnic minority poverty and living-standards statistics
find_a_url.publisher: GSO / World Bank-aligned and national poverty monitoring
find_a_url.description: Poverty rates and living-standards indicators disaggregated by ethnicity. Ethnic minorities account for a large majority of remaining poverty despite representing a minority of the population; absolute numbers of poor ethnic minorities have fallen substantially over the past decade.
find_a_url.what_we_hit: Still not found. The NSO/GSO living-standards pages that carry poverty by ethnicity (VHLSS 2024 results; 'Thanh tuu giam ngheo ... 2016-2022') exist as URLs on www.nso.gov.vn / www.gso.gov.vn, but every WebFetch of a content page on those hosts failed (robots.txt ConnectTimeout) across ~10 spaced attempts. One fetch of www.gso.gov.vn/en/homepage/ did succeed, so the host is alive but effectively unfetchable; nothing was retrieved that shows ethnic-disaggregated poverty, so no URL is returned.

find_a_url.title: Ho Chi Minh City Gross Regional Domestic Product
find_a_url.publisher: General Statistics Office / local statistical office
find_a_url.description: Official GRDP for Ho Chi Minh City — Vietnam’s largest urban economy and southern commercial/industrial hub. Together with Hanoi forms the dual-core national economic structure.
find_a_url.what_we_hit: Still not found. The successor host does exist - thongkehochiminh.nso.gov.vn (Chi Cuc Thong ke TP. Ho Chi Minh, with /Niengiam/Niengiam and /Thongbao/... paths) - but every WebFetch against it, and against the older thongkehochiminh.gso.gov.vn and cucthongke.hcmcso.gov.vn, timed out on robots.txt over ~8 spaced attempts. No HCMC GRDP page was actually retrieved, so no URL is returned.

find_a_url.title: Vietnam–Korea trade and FDI statistics
find_a_url.description: Bilateral trade and investment with the Republic of Korea. Korea is a top-three export market, major import source and consistently among the largest FDI sources (electronics, manufacturing, consumer industries).
find_a_url.what_we_hit: Still not found. The right document is MOFA's 'Tai lieu co ban ve Han Quoc va quan he Viet Nam - Han Quoc' (the sister page for Japan was retrieved successfully and does carry both trade turnover and FDI), but mofa.gov.vn returned HTTP 502 for the Korea page on every one of ~5 spaced attempts, as did the legacy path /vi/cn_vakv/ca_tbd/... and the dsq.mofa.gov.vn mirror. Vietnam Customs' bilateral statistics pages (customs.gov.vn/index.jsp?pageId=442) render only via JavaScript and yield no content to WebFetch.

find_a_url.title: State budget deficit statistics
find_a_url.description: Official deficit figures for the state budget (central and local components) as a share of GDP and in absolute terms. Closely monitored against National Assembly targets.
find_a_url.what_we_hit: Still not found. Route 1 did identify the exact official location: Vietnam's NSDP (nsdp.nso.gov.vn) names ckns.mof.gov.vn/Lists/GDDSManager/Attachments/19/MoF GGO_Vietnam.xls as the official 'General Government Operations' series (revenue, expenditure, balance). ckns.mof.gov.vn responded once (SitePages/default.aspx) but every attempt to fetch the GGO attachment or the budget-disclosure list pages timed out, so the deficit data itself was never retrieved. mof.gov.vn serves a JavaScript shell and qln.mof.gov.vn (the former debt-management department host that published Ban tin no cong) no longer resolves at all.

find_a_url.title: Ho Chi Minh City / Cai Mep port complex operational statistics
find_a_url.region: Southeast / Ho Chi Minh City area
find_a_url.description: Operational statistics for the southern gateway complex (Ho Chi Minh City Port / Cat Lai and the deep-water Cai Mep–Thi Vai cluster). Together they form Vietnam’s largest container handling concentration and rank among the world’s top container ports by volume and performance.
find_a_url.what_we_hit: Still not found. vinamarine.gov.vn (Vietnam Maritime Administration) is reachable but renders its content through JavaScript - the homepage yields only the hotline block and no navigation URLs, and no sitemap.xml could be fetched. No per-port throughput product for Cat Lai / Cai Mep - Thi Vai was retrieved on any government or port-authority domain.

find_a_url.title: Hai Phong port operational statistics
find_a_url.description: Operational statistics for Hai Phong — the principal northern gateway port. Ranks among the world’s top container ports by volume and has recorded strong performance-index gains.
find_a_url.what_we_hit: Still not found, for the same reason as the southern complex: the maritime administration site (vinamarine.gov.vn) is JavaScript-only to WebFetch and publishes national, not per-port, throughput; no Hai Phong port-authority statistics page was retrieved.

find_a_url.title: Ethnic minority population and composition statistics
find_a_url.description: Official statistics on Vietnam’s 54 ethnic groups. The Kinh majority forms the large bulk of the population; ethnic minorities (approximately 15 % of the total) are concentrated especially in the Midlands and Northern Mountains and the Central Highlands.
find_a_url.what_we_hit: Still not found. The correct official product was located by reference - the NSO's standard classification 'Danh muc cac dan toc Viet Nam' at www.nso.gov.vn/phuong-phap-luan-thong-ke/danh-muc/cac-dan-toc-viet-nam/, which is linked from the (reachable) thongkehanoi.nso.gov.vn navigation - but www.nso.gov.vn and www.gso.gov.vn refused every WebFetch attempt (robots.txt ConnectTimeout). ubdt.gov.vn (Committee for Ethnic Minorities) answered once but its certificate has expired and subsequent fetches failed. Nothing was actually retrieved showing the 54 groups or their population shares.

find_a_url.title: Vietnam–China land border treaty and border management framework
find_a_url.description: Legal and institutional framework stemming from the 1999 Land Border Treaty and subsequent demarcation/management agreements. Provides the foundation for orderly border trade, BEZs and local cooperation.
find_a_url.what_we_hit: Still not found. The National Boundary Commission site biengioilanhtho.gov.vn was retrieved once at the homepage, which confirms a 'Van kien phap ly' section at /vi/van-kien-phap-ly.html containing a Vietnam-China land border category - but that section page failed on ~6 spaced attempts (robots.txt ConnectTimeout / parse failure), so the 1999 Land Border Treaty page itself was never seen.

find_a_url.title: Policy and development banking institutions (VBSP and related)
find_a_url.publisher: Vietnam Bank for Social Policies / SBV related
find_a_url.description: Statistics and institutional role of the Vietnam Bank for Social Policies and other policy-oriented credit institutions that target poverty reduction, rural development and social objectives.
find_a_url.what_we_hit: Still not found. vbsp.org.vn (Vietnam Bank for Social Policies) is reachable at the homepage but WebFetch sees only article body text - no navigation URLs are exposed - and /gioi-thieu/bao-cao-thuong-nien.html plus /sitemap.xml failed repeatedly (TLS chain error / robots parse failure). No annual report or statistics page was confirmed.

find_a_url.title: Public debt and government debt statistics
find_a_url.description: Official public debt, government debt and external debt ratios relative to GDP, together with related debt-service indicators. Maintained well below statutory ceilings in recent years (public debt typically mid-30s % of GDP).
find_a_url.what_we_hit: Still not found. Route 1 pinned the official locations: Vietnam's NSDP lists 'Central Government Gross Debt' and 'External Debt' as MOF series at ckns.mof.gov.vn/Lists/GDDSManager/Attachments/17/... and .../15/Z_EXD_VNM.xlsx. Neither attachment could be fetched (repeated timeouts). The Ban tin no cong (public debt bulletin) formerly at qln.mof.gov.vn no longer resolves (DNS failure) and mof.gov.vn returns a JavaScript shell with no content.

find_a_url.title: National defence policy framing
find_a_url.publisher: Ministry of National Defence / Party-State documents
find_a_url.description: Official national defence policy emphasising peace, self-defence, non-use of force, peaceful settlement of disputes, and gradual modernisation of the Vietnam People’s Army sufficient for self-defence. Continuously cited in security and foreign-policy analysis.
find_a_url.what_we_hit: Still not found. mod.gov.vn (Ministry of National Defence portal) resolves and responds but returns an empty document to WebFetch - no text, no links, and no robots.txt/sitemap - so the 2019 National Defence White Paper page could not be located or confirmed on any official domain.

find_a_url.title: Vietnam–China Comprehensive Strategic Partnership framing
find_a_url.description: Highest-tier bilateral relationship (Comprehensive Strategic Partnership since 2008). Continuously referenced in trade, investment, border management and South China Sea discussions.
find_a_url.our_verdict: searched properly; no such published series found
find_a_url.what_we_hit: Still not found. MOFA's country dossier 'Tai lieu co ban ve Trung Quoc va quan he Viet Nam - Trung Quoc' exists at mofa.gov.vn/tin-chi-tiet/chi-tiet/tai-lieu-co-ban-ve-trung-quoc-va-quan-he-viet-nam-trung-quoc-589.html but returned HTTP 502 on every attempt (~4, spaced), as did the /vi/ variant and the dsq.mofa.gov.vn copy. The Vietnamese Embassy in Beijing homepage was retrieved and does expose /cac-moc-trong-quan-he-song-phuong, but that sub-page also 502s. No joint-statement page could be retrieved.

find_a_url.title: Vietnam–China trade structure (electronics, intermediates, agriculture)
find_a_url.description: Commodity composition of bilateral trade. Vietnam imports large volumes of intermediate goods, components and machinery from China; exports electronics, telephones, agricultural products and other goods. Structural deficit with China is a recurring feature.
find_a_url.our_verdict: searched properly; no such published series found
find_a_url.what_we_hit: Still not found. Vietnam Customs is the right publisher and its analytical series lives at customs.gov.vn/index.jsp?pageId=442&tkId=..., but both www.customs.gov.vn and the regional mirrors return only page metadata to WebFetch (content is rendered client-side), so no commodity-composition page for Vietnam-China trade could be confirmed. asemconnectvietnam.gov.vn (MOIT) timed out.

find_a_url.title: Vietnam–China Border Economic Zones and cross-border cooperation
find_a_url.description: Border Economic Zones (BEZs) and Cross-Border Economic Cooperation Zones along the Vietnam–China land border (Lao Cai, Mong Cai, Dong Dang, Cao Bang and related pairs). Focus of infrastructure, trade facilitation and local economic development.
find_a_url.our_verdict: searched properly; no such published series found
find_a_url.what_we_hit: Still not found. vanban.chinhphu.vn is reachable and would hold the relevant Prime Ministerial decisions on border-gate economic zones, but the portal is addressable only by internal docid and its keyword search could not be driven through WebFetch; with the session's web-search budget exhausted there was no way to resolve a decision number to a docid. No border-economic-zone page was retrieved.

find_a_url.title: Vietnam–China Community with a Shared Future framing
find_a_url.description: Elevated political framing (Community with a shared future that carries strategic significance) that sits above the Comprehensive Strategic Cooperative Partnership. Continuously referenced in joint statements and high-level visits.
find_a_url.our_verdict: searched properly; no such published series found
